items.question: What is the size of the endowment fund that the Mothers' Endowment campaign in the UAE aims to establish?
items.fact: Mothers' Endowment campaign aims for AED 1 billion endowment fund.

items.question: Under which umbrella does the Mothers' Endowment campaign in the UAE run?
items.gold: Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Global Initiatives.
items.fact: Mothers' Endowment runs under Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Global Initiatives.
